brushes.name: Pressure Inker
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Crisp ink line that swells with pressure and tapers at both ends. Made for clean line art.

brushes.name: Soft Shader
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Feathered airy round for gentle shading and glows. Builds up slowly with pressure.

brushes.name: Canvas Weave
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Paints with a woven canvas grain: crossing threads that show in every stroke. Best at size 20 and up.

brushes.name: Twin Liner
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Draws two parallel lines that follow your stroke, for outlined lettering and doubled line art.

brushes.name: Watercolor Wash
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Wet wash that blooms and granulates into the paper as it dries.

brushes.name: Oil Impasto
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Thick oil paint that builds raised, lit strokes and blends with wet paint underneath.

brushes.name: Stipple Spray
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Scatters irregular dots for stipple shading, sparkles and rough texture.

brushes.name: Chisel Marker
brushes.author: Paintnix
brushes.description: Flat slanted nib for calligraphic marker strokes: thick on the downstroke, thin across.
